Definition: Arach, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Arach is the name of several Israelites. One is a son of Ulla among the sons of Asher, one is the father of a family of 775 who returned from exile with Zerubbabel, one is the father of Shechaniah, whose son married Tobiah's daughter, and the family of Arah is counted again in Nehemiah's census.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the returning families are the quiet proof that exile did not end Israel, because God kept the names and brought the people home.
